learnings: Implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) on individual files to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts when other models can cover the file.

Add detection for model hallucinations where the model generates fake file contents (e.g., using XML tags like <file name=...>) instead of analyzing the provided files, and discard or flag such reports.
When aggregating verdicts, if one model successfully audits a file that another model failed to audit due to a tool error, the successful audit should satisfy the coverage requirement for that file.
